{{Quote|Your intrepid reporter recently concluded his tour of shrines by visiting the sanctuary on Boztrok.|TriNebulon News report by Andor Javin|<ref name="Journal13" />}}
A '''Shrine of Kooroo''' located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Boztrok]] was one of a series of similar, ancient [[Shrine of Kooroo|stone structures]] that were believed to have been constructed by an advanced [[Kooroo (species)|alien species]] on several worlds throughout known [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. The shrine on Boztrok was located on an [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]-surrounded island that was part of an archipelago, and atypically for a Shrine of Kooroo, it was not surrounded by a series of [[Writing/Legends|rune]]-inscribed stone obelisks.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Boztrok Shrine of Kooroo was part of an estate owned by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] art [[Collector/Legends|collector]] [[Prebda Thok]]. Each [[Standard day/Legends|day]], the shrine was visited by [[Pilgrimage of Kooroo|pilgrims]] of the [[Fellowship of Kooroo]], a cult dedicated to the worship of the structures. The pilgrims were accompanied across Thok's estate grounds by an armed escort and [[Meditation/Legends|meditated]] inside the shrine. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], the [[TriNebulon News/Legends|TriNebulon News]] [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Andor Javin]] visited the Boztrok shrine as part of his tour to several of the Shrines of Kooroo. Following his visit to the shrine, Javin transmitted a [[NewsNet]] report describing his theories about the construction of the ancient structures.

==Description==
{{Quote|The inner sanctum consists of a central domed chamber, with a raised step along the perimeter where pilgrims sit and meditate.|TriNebulon News report by Andor Javin|<ref name="Journal13" />}}
A [[Shrine of Kooroo]] was located on the<ref name="Journal13" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Boztrok system/Legends|Boztrok system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Boztrok]]. The shrine was situated on the largest island in the archipelago that constituted most of [[Boztrok starport|Boztrok spaceport]].<ref name="Journal13" />

Like most of the other Shrines of Kooroo located on several worlds<ref name="Journal13" /> throughout known [[Realspace/Legends|space]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the ancient ruin on Boztrok consisted of<ref name="Journal13" /> a three-level central structure built out of the same type of native stone as the other shrines.<ref name="Journal14 Shrines" /> The Boztrok shrine featured an inner sanctuary in the form of a central domed chamber. A pedestal was located at the sanctum's center, and a raised low step ran around the room's perimeter. Although the main structure of a Shrine of Kooroo was usually surrounded by a series of stone obelisks inscribed with [[Writing/Legends|runes]], no such outlying structures had been discovered on the island housing the Boztrok shrine.<ref name="Journal13" />

==History==
{{Quote|The shrine was located on his ''[Prebda Thok's]'' exclusive island estate, where numerous bodyguards and soldiers escort dedicated pilgrims of Kooroo to and from the ruin each day. ''[&hellip;]'' Unfortunately, no carved obelisks were discovered on the island, although I believe these monuments to be submerged beneath the surrounding ocean.|TriNebulon News report by Andor Javin|<ref name="Journal13" />}}
[[File:ShrineofKooroo-Journal14.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Shrine of Kooroo on Boztrok was similar to other such structures (a typical Shrine of Kooroo depicted) on several Outer Rim worlds.]]
By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the medium-sized island on which the Boztrok Shrine of Kooroo was located formed a part of an exclusive estate owned by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] art [[Collector/Legends|collector]] [[Prebda Thok]]. Dedicated members of the [[Fellowship of Kooroo]], a cult worshipping the Shrines of Kooroo, visited the island estate [[Standard day/Legends|daily]] as part of a [[Pilgrimage of Kooroo|pilgrimage]]<ref name="Journal13" /> to various sites connected to the organization's supposed spiritual leader, [[Kooroo (being)|Kooroo]].<ref name="Platt">''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]''</ref> On the grounds of Thok's estate, a large number of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] escorted the pilgrims to and from the Shrine of Kooroo. Inside the shrine, the pilgrims sat on the raised step running around the sanctum's perimeter and [[Meditation/Legends|meditated]].<ref name="Journal13" />

In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="2 ABY">{{JournalCite|13|Galaxywide NewsNets}} &mdash; [[Andor Javin]] transmitted his [[NewsNet]] report from [[Boztrok]], which followed his visit to the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Shrine of Kooroo]], on the date 38:1:15, which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> the sensationalist<ref name="Journal14">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}</ref> investigative [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Andor Javin]] visited the Boztrok shrine at the conclusion of a tour to several of the worlds housing Shrines of Kooroo. The [[NewsNet]] reporter's visit to Thok's estate was hosted by the collector, and Javin came to believe that the stone obelisks which should have formed a part of the shrine were submerged beneath the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] that surrounded the island.<ref name="Journal13" />

On the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] 38:1:15, following his visit to the shrine, Javin transmitted a [[TriNebulon News/Legends|TriNebulon News]] report from [[Thokisl]], Boztrok. In the report, Javin briefly described his visit to the Boztrok shrine. In addition, Javin claimed that the supposedly primitive Shrines of Kooroo were constructed by an advanced [[Kooroo (species)|alien species]], which used the structures for interstellar communication based on either technological [[Comm unit/Legends|comm]] devices or [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathy]].<ref name="Journal13" /> By [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]],<ref name="11 ABY">"[[From the Files of Corellia Antilles]]" is set "shortly after the re-establishment of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]" following the [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|final death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].</ref> general consensus among [[Scholar/Legends|scholars]] agreed that the Shrines of Kooroo were built by an ancient [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]], although the purpose of the structures was still unclear by that time.<ref name="Journal14" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Boztrok Shrine of Kooroo was mentioned in the "[[Galaxywide NewsNets]]" feature of the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 13|thirteenth issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'', which was published in [[May]] [[1997]]. The feature was authored by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]].<ref name="Journal13" />
